info.name: IRoad — Driver Issue Report (All Types)
info.description:
Report operational issues / delays for an active shipment.

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/mobile/driver/issues/report/`

**Auth:** `Bearer {{access_token}}` + capability `mobile.driver.issues`

### issue_type (all 8)
`delay`, `vehicle_breakdown`, `customer_unavailable`, `payment_dispute`, `pod_issue`, `accident`, `route_blocked`, `other`

### severity (all 4)
`low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`

### Required fields
- `client_issue_id` — idempotency key (unique per driver per tenant)
- `shipment_id` — shipment UUID or `shipment_no`
- `issue_type`, `severity`

### Optional
- `notes`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `media[]`

Import `IRoad-Driver-Issue-Report.postman_environment.json` and run **00 Login** first.

item.name: 00 — Setup (Login)
item.description: Get `access_token` before reporting issues. Set `shipment_id` to an active job you own.

item.name: 01 — Report Delay (all severities)
item.description: Delay reports with each severity. `blocking_recommended` is true for medium, high, and critical.

item.name: 02 — All issue types
item.description: One request per `issue_type` with a typical severity.

request.description: Multipart upload via `process_media_files`. Select a JPG/PNG file for `media[0][file_ref]`. Do not set Content-Type manually.
Run after **Delay — severity medium** (or any request that sets `issue_replay_client_issue_id`). Expect HTTP **200** and `replayed: true`.
